concrete_gaps.gap: Explicit model query loses model scope: when parser resolves a brand but THAI_MODEL_MAP has no model (English queries), branch sets resolvedQ=undefined → brand-wide search. 'Honda City' → manufacturer=honda, q=undefined → returns Accord/Civic/CR-V (arbitrary same-brand). Violates A (exact-model-first).
concrete_gaps.fix: modelPhrase = parser entities (word-boundary known models) else parseBrandModelQuery leftover (year/stopword-free); brand-only (no model term) keeps existing q=undefined behavior

concrete_gaps.gap: Substring-colliding Thai model aliases are JOINED into one phrase that no field contains: 'ยาริส ครอส'→q='yaris yaris cross', 'เอพี พลัส'→q='ep ep plus' → 0 results while Yaris Cross has 1 official priced variant. Exact entity specificity erased. Violates E.
concrete_gaps.fix: drop any resolvedModel that is a substring of another resolvedModel (keep maximal/most specific); single phrase otherwise; non-overlapping multi-model join unchanged (pre-existing fail-closed limitation, documented)

concrete_gaps.gap: /api/search never uses searchHybrid (observation 1); vectorAvailable hardcoded false (untruthful when EMBEDDING_BASE_URL set). AND searchHybrid returns RAW searchVectorEvidence output without applyEvidenceThresholds — wiring it as-is would expose ungated evidence (violates B/C).
concrete_gaps.fix: route calls searchHybrid(filters); hybrid applies applyEvidenceThresholds(filters.q, vector) and strips the internal 'qualified' flag from returned evidence rows (response shape VectorEvidence unchanged)

concrete_gaps.gap: Exact-match branch maps variant.prices verbatim from exactModelRetrieval (isCurrent ONLY): 334/352 current prices fail official+verified chain, yet ask route flags structured evidence official:true → non-official current price claimable as VERIFIED. Violates D/A (structured official catalog authoritative).
concrete_gaps.fix: filter mapped prices to the same official chain as queries.ts (VERIFIED doc + ACTIVE official source + VERIFIED verification + isCurrent); drop variants with zero qualifying prices (same eligibility as searchCatalog)

concrete_gaps.gap: Explicit-model queries fall back to buildSearchTerms which keeps brand tokens ('honda'/'mg') → searchCatalog(q:'honda') brand-wide results merge into answers → same-brand guessing (CR-V/Civic for 'honda city'). Violates D 'never same-brand guessing'.
concrete_gaps.fix: when explicit model scope exists (entities or parseBrandModelQuery model), drop brand-only terms from fallback search terms

concrete_gaps.gap: No canonical identity check on exact hits: slug 'mg-ep' resolves model 'EP Plus' for query 'MG EP' (DB slug collision) → short-token collision returns cross-model rows as exact match once price eligibility passes. Violates A/C.
concrete_gaps.fix: reuse evidence-gate-policy canonical identity: export a thin helper over canonicalIdentityMatch (same rules as gateVectorEvidence layer 2: reject isExcluded or differing non-null identities; accept when either side has no canonical identity) and apply to exactModelRetrieval hits in smartCatalogSearch using the ORIGINAL query

concrete_gaps.gap: Exact-model-first never runs for short models unknown to parser entities ('MG EP': extractEntities=[] → exact branch skipped → falls straight to brand-term search). Violates A.
concrete_gaps.fix: trigger exact branch when intent.type==='search' AND (entities.length>0 OR parseBrandModelQuery(question).model) — fullQuery=question when model scope from parser, entities.join when from entities
